chunks: Everything in it that is from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah, I have narrated from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh al-Qadi.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; part of the author’s immediate transmission link.
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: Al-Himyari; the lineage designation of 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far in the chain.
key_terms.الْقَاضِيِ: Al-Qadi; the judicial title attached to Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s route of narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage is not a substantive hadith text but a clarification of the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. It identifies the transmission route used by the author, linking the report through named narrators back to Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah ibn Shurayh al-Qadi.
